de:
Das Modell kann die von der Kanzlei ausgewählten Dokumente und Mitteilungen, noch nicht veröffentlichte Logos und Fotos, Namen und Biografien von Personen, Kontaktdaten, Leistungen, Qualifikationen, bestätigte Fakten und Rechtstexte erhalten. Zur Erstellung des Briefings kann es jede ausgewählte Quelle vollständig lesen. Für jede Quelle hält das Briefing den beruflichen Zweck, den weiteren Bedarf und die genaue Seite, Passage oder Datei fest. Der Code prüft nur, ob jede Quelle abgedeckt ist und der Plan die erforderliche Struktur hat; er entscheidet nicht über die fachliche Relevanz.

Erstellung und Prüfung verwenden danach das Briefing, nur diese Materialien, Struktur- und Textentwürfe, Website-Dateien sowie Desktop- und Telefon-Screenshots. Eine vollständige Quelle wird nur erneut geöffnet, wenn der Plan sie aus einem dokumentierten beruflichen Grund als notwendig ausweist. Es greift nicht auf das allgemeine Kanzleiarchiv, Mandantenakten, das Postfach oder nicht ausgewählte Dateien zu.

Das Modell erhält Quellen innerhalb derselben Grenzen; der optionale OpenAI-Sites-Adapter und Veröffentlichungsweg ist nur in Codex verfügbar. Es erfolgt keine automatische Anonymisierung.
en:
The model may receive the documents and communications selected by the firm, unpublished logos and photographs, people's names and biographies, contact details, services, qualifications, confirmed facts, and legal text. To prepare the brief, the model may read each selected source in full. For every source, the brief records its professional purpose, whether it is still needed, and the exact page, excerpt, or asset required. Code checks only that every source is covered and that the plan has the required shape; it does not decide what is professionally relevant.

Building and review then use the brief, only those materials, proposed structure and copy, site files, and desktop and phone screenshots. A full source is reopened only when the plan marks it as necessary for a recorded professional reason. It does not access the firm's general archive, client matters, mailbox, or unselected files.

The model receives sources within the same limits; the optional OpenAI Sites adapter and publication route is available only in Codex. There is no automatic anonymization.

Para preparar el brief, puede leer íntegramente cada fuente seleccionada. El código solo comprueba que cada fuente esté cubierta y que el plan tenga la estructura requerida; no decide la relevancia profesional.

it:
Possono entrare nel modello i documenti e le comunicazioni scelti dallo Studio, logo e fotografie non ancora pubblicati, nomi e biografie delle persone, recapiti, servizi, qualifiche, fatti confermati e testi legali. Per preparare il brief, il modello può leggere per intero ogni fonte selezionata. Per ciascuna fonte, il brief registra lo scopo professionale, se serve ancora e la pagina, l'estratto o la risorsa esatta necessaria. Il codice controlla soltanto che ogni fonte sia coperta e che il piano abbia la struttura richiesta; non decide che cosa sia professionalmente rilevante.

Costruzione e revisione usano poi il brief, quei soli materiali, struttura e bozze, file del sito e schermate desktop e telefono. Una fonte completa viene riaperta solo quando il piano la indica come necessaria per una ragione professionale registrata. Non accede all'archivio generale dello Studio, alle pratiche dei clienti, alla posta o a file non selezionati.

Il modello riceve le fonti entro gli stessi limiti; il percorso opzionale OpenAI Sites per adattare e pubblicare il sito è disponibile solo in Codex. Non è prevista anonimizzazione automatica.

security_controls.control: Workspace initialization requires asserted owner, retention owner, explicit user confirmation and an exact directory outside a Git repository or published static/shared root. Files, symlinks, filesystem roots, the home directory and non-empty unmanaged directories are rejected. Run outputs use owner-only permissions, atomic JSON replacement and a private staging directory before the run becomes visible.

Run preparation requires at least one regular non-symlink selected file or one exact fact explicitly confirmed by the user in conversation, and every selected item must carry approved_for_website_use=true for the website purpose. Files are copied into the private run and confirmed facts are serialized into immutable evidence snapshots; each records the website-use approval, byte size and SHA-256, duplicate evidence IDs are rejected and intake plus source register are bound to one digest. Every later gate rechecks the approval and rehashes the snapshots. A public URL alone is not treated as captured evidence.

The site brief records exactly one source-use item for every registered evidence ID. The model states the professional purpose and chooses mapped_brief_only, targeted_material or full_source_required; deterministic code verifies only schema shape, unique IDs and exact source-register coverage. Downstream design, copy and build work use mapped brief facts by default, reopen only the named targeted material when required, and use a complete selected source only when the recorded professional reason requires it. No deterministic keyword or personal-data classifier substitutes for that semantic judgment.

Information architecture, copy, visual direction and rendered quality remain model-led proposals. Every studio-profile field is labelled observed, user supplied or Vera default; observed and user-supplied fields require selected evidence IDs, and claim records cannot reference an unknown source ID. Deterministic code does not decide aesthetics, professional truth, accessibility compliance or legal sufficiency.

The validator recomputes a complete file inventory and site digest and checks only mechanically verifiable properties including metadata, one H1, alternative-text presence, duplicate IDs, local reference closure, unsafe schemes, placeholders and preview indexing posture. Forms, embedded documents, iframes, remote active scripts and executable data URLs are blocked because the workflow is scoped to informational sites; passive HTTPS assets remain visible warnings.

The model-led browser assessment must include distinct desktop and phone viewports with retained PNG paths, hashes and verified dimensions, bind current site and validation digests, identify its weakest element and cannot be ready with viewport issues, console issues or weak or blocked dimensions. Identity-and-claims, responsive-preview and publication-destination decisions are recorded separately against the same current evidence, brief, site, validation and quality-assessment digests; any changed dependency or screenshot bytes invalidate stale reviews and packages.

Preview and release packages reject every symlink and non-regular file, copy exact site bytes atomically, record and rehash every packaged file, and bind intake, brief, validation, quality-assessment and current review digests. Preview packaging additionally requires an explicitly selected route and noindex, nofollow and noarchive on every HTML page; release packaging rejects every preview robots directive and requires all current professional review scopes. Delivery recording revalidates the complete package, exact selected destination, non-empty user confirmation and visible URL or provider receipt. Sites deliveries additionally bind the exact website payload to the current Vera package, source commit, deployment archive, project metadata, server bundle, saved version, succeeded deployment and deployed browser evidence.

Explicit host tenant/operator/workspace/run bindings, verified source/quality/whole-workspace bytes, exact current scope and private draft CAS govern native review. Writes require reviewer role, exact saved literal fields, renewed confirmation and durable idempotent intents. Complete current reviews, screenshot hashes and selected external-route posture remain public-producer prerequisites. Changed or uncertain outcomes refuse automatic replay; exact retained receipts are revalidated. Native helpers invoke only maintained local validation/review/package/Sites-binding producers, never deploy, upload or record fabricated delivery. Only exact declared current artifacts are downloadable; original sources and arbitrary paths are excluded. Separate actual site browser QA and installed host acceptance remain unverified.
